duas.title: Seeking Guidance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, righteousness, chastity and self-sufficiency.

duas.title: For Beneficial Knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provisions, and accepted deeds.

duas.title: For Gratitude
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve.

duas.title: For Increase in Knowledge
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: For Rizq (Sustenance)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalaalika 'an haraamika wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwaak
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have permitted so that I have no need of that which You have forbidden, and make me independent of all besides You.
